project.name: LTT Sales Platform
project.name_ar: نظام متابعة الوكلاء وموظفي وحدة عمليات المراكز والوكلاء
project.owner: Libya Telecom & Technology (LTT) — Retail Sales Department, Western Region
project.language: Arabic (RTL) primary UI, code/comments in English

objective: Build a full-stack enterprise web platform to manage telecom retail agents, company-owned entities (service centers, fixed POS, mobile vans), field inspections, licenses/documents with expiry tracking, tickets, inventory, analytics, and an interactive map. Includes a separate public Arabic RTL field-inspection form used by inspectors on-site.

frontend.font: Cairo (Arabic) loaded via <link> in index.html — NOT @import in CSS

backend.auth: Custom HMAC token signed with SESSION_SECRET, stored in localStorage as ltt_token

stack.api_contract: OpenAPI spec → Orval codegen producing React Query hooks + Zod schemas

monorepo_structure.artifacts/agent-request-form: React+Vite Arabic RTL field inspection form, mounted at /form/
monorepo_structure.lib/api-client-react: React Query hooks generated from OpenAPI (@workspace/api-client-react)

database_schema.users: id, fullName, email (unique), passwordHash, role, department, isActive, createdAt
database_schema.agents: id, name, city, address, phone, email, latitude, longitude, classification (A-E), channelType, region, services (jsonb), supervisorId, marketPotential, operationalEval, contractStart, contractEnd, assignedSalesRepId, notes
database_schema.agent_requests: Multi-purpose entity table. id, requestId (LTT-XX-NNN), entityType (agent|service_center|fixed_pos|mobile_van|inspection), entityName, responsibleEmployee, employeePhone, address, latitude, longitude, services (jsonb), staffCount, activityType (nullable), agentId (fk), status (pending|approved|rejected|cancelled), formData (jsonb), photos (jsonb), createdAt
database_schema.agent_documents: id, agentId, type, number, issueDate, expiryDate, fileUrl, uploadedBy, createdAt
database_schema.tickets: id, title, description, priority, status, createdById, assignedToId, agentId (nullable), locationName, latitude, longitude, createdAt

management_platform.description: KPI cards, document alert banner (expired/expiring), risk pie, agent ranking bar, recent inspections, 'tickets assigned to you' panel
Field inspection reports list, status workflow, entity-type filter + colored badges, CSV export, 'create new operation' modal with 4 entity-type tiles. Admin-only.
Agent cards with score/classification/doc-status badges (red=expired, amber=expiring, green=valid), CRUD, detail modal with scoring breakdown, CSV export
Full license/document management: CRUD, expiry tracking, file upload, history log, CSV export
Manage company-owned entities (service_center, fixed_pos, mobile_van) — colored type cards, search/filter, approve/cancel, edit modal, 'open in Google Maps' button
Leaflet map of all 190 agents + entities, color-coded markers by type, type filters with counts, popups with contact info + Google Maps directions link, CSV export of filtered points
Multi-chart analytics: city breakdown, risk pie, radar chart, sales comparison

Ticket list with priority/status badges, 5 preset titles (inspection, new agent, service center, fixed POS, mobile van), assignee dropdown, optional location with map picker, 'my tickets' filter toggle
Team member cards with role badges. Admin: add/edit/delete users, reseed-from-dev button

field_inspection_form.description: Arabic RTL inspection form. Mode selector: inspect existing agent / register new agent. Fetches agents from /api/agents (no static lists). New-agent flow: class A–E, channel type, GPS, readiness scoring, document uploads via reusable DocUploadRow component (avoids React hooks-in-map violations). Service center & fixed POS selectors pull from /api/agent-requests?entityType=...

key_features.assigned_tickets_popup: After login, shows modal listing user's open assigned tickets with priority badges and link to /tickets
key_features.form_db_sync: Field form fetches live from /api/agents and /api/agent-requests (entity types) — no static lists
key_features.document_status: Auto-computed expired/expiring/valid status with shared color/label utilities
key_features.ticket_map_picker: Reusable Leaflet MapPickerModal lets admin click on map to set ticket lat/lng
key_features.preset_ticket_titles: 5 fixed tiles auto-fill location + agent from selected entity
key_features.auto_seed_on_empty: API server has bootstrapData.ts that auto-loads embedded seed-snapshot.sql when users table is empty (used for production initial deploy)

seeded_data.users: 19 real LTT team members (default password LTT@2024) + admin
seeded_data.agents: 190 real dealers across Western Region (deduplicated by normalized name, ~393 total entries)
seeded_data.entities: 14 company-owned (service centers, fixed POS, mobile vans)

ui_design.language: Arabic (RTL) — every page must have dir='rtl'
ui_design.tone: Enterprise, clean, modern. White cards on light background, primary brand color for CTAs
ui_design.components: shadcn/ui as base; custom modals follow rounded-xl + shadow-xl pattern

critical_pitfalls_to_avoid: Tailwind v4: Google Fonts must be loaded via <link> in index.html, NEVER @import url() in CSS (breaks PostCSS)
Tailwind v4: Do NOT @import 'tw-animate-css' — incompatible, causes 500 errors
Vite base path: use base: basePath unconditionally (Replit-style proxy does not rewrite paths)
Never call React hooks (useRef/useState) inside .map() — extract to a named component
DB column is fullName (not name); user passwordHash must be stripped from API responses
Tickets table uses createdById (not reportedById) FK column
Agent requests list route is plural (GET /api/agent-requests); status PATCH is singular (PATCH /api/agent-request/:id/status)
When auto-seeding production, strip psql meta-commands (\) and ALTER TABLE ... DISABLE/ENABLE TRIGGER ALL lines from snapshots — managed Postgres rejects them with 42501
build_instructions_for_ai: 1. Bootstrap pnpm monorepo with workspaces and TypeScript strict mode
2. Create lib/db with Drizzle schema for all tables listed above
3. Create lib/api-spec with OpenAPI 3.1 contract covering all endpoints, then run Orval codegen for Zod schemas (lib/api-zod) and React Query hooks (lib/api-client-react)

4. Build artifacts/api-server (Express 5): Zod-validated routes, HMAC token auth middleware, pino logging, route files per resource (auth, users, agents, agent-requests, documents, tickets, inventory, analytics, admin)
5. Build artifacts/ltt-platform (React+Vite): wouter routing, TanStack Query, Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, all pages above, Arabic RTL throughout, Cairo font via <link>
6. Build artifacts/agent-request-form (React+Vite): Arabic RTL inspection form pulling live data from API, reusable DocUploadRow + PhotoUploadSection components
7. Seed real data: 19 users, 190 agents from CSV, 14 company entities, sample tickets/inventory
8. Admin features last: gate delete/edit/reseed buttons by role, add/edit user modal, reseed-from-snapshot button
